stats.value: 2,261,080 individuals had an interest in at least one rental property in 2022–23
stats.notes: Out of roughly 16 million individuals who lodged tax returns. The share of people with no investment property is therefore roughly 85% of taxfilers (about 80% if measured against the ~11.4 million net taxpayers). Site copy uses 'more than 8 in 10' to stay robust to the choice of denominator.

stats.value: Negative gearing reduced personal income tax revenue by about $10.9 billion in 2023–24
stats.source: Treasury analysis, reported in The Conversation

stats.value: Around 83% of the benefit of the current CGT discount goes to the top 10% of taxpayers by income
stats.source: Prime Minister of Australia, media release on tax reform (Budget 2026–27)
stats.notes: Consistent with Grattan Institute's submission on reforming the CGT discount.

stats.value: About 810,000 adults — around 5% of individual taxfilers — received distributions from discretionary trusts in 2022–23 (plus about 120,000 non-filers, predominantly minors)
stats.source: Australian Government, Budget 2026–27 factsheet: Minimum tax on discretionary trusts
stats.notes: The factsheet states more than 95% of individual taxfilers will not be affected in any given year.

stats.value: Properties acquired (contract date) before 7:30pm AEST on 12 May 2026 are not affected by the negative gearing changes
stats.source: ATO — New legislation: Reforming negative gearing and capital gains tax
stats.notes: For established properties acquired after Budget night, rental losses are quarantined against rental income and gains from 1 July 2027. New builds retain full negative gearing.

stats.value: Gains accrued before 1 July 2027 keep the 50% discount; indexation and the 30% minimum tax apply only to gains accrued after that date
stats.source: Baker McKenzie, Budget Bites — CGT Discount and Negative Gearing
stats.notes: Asset owners can use a formal valuation at 1 July 2027 or an ATO apportionment formula to split pre- and post-reform gains.

stats.value: Excluded from the trust minimum tax: testamentary trusts in existence on 12 May 2026, special disability trusts, deceased estates, charitable trusts, fixed and widely held trusts, and complying super funds; primary production income and certain income of vulnerable minors are also carved out
stats.source: Australian Government, Budget 2026–27 factsheet: Minimum tax on discretionary trusts

stats.value: Around 350,000 active small businesses — fewer than 15% of all active small businesses — operate through a discretionary trust
stats.source: Australian Government, Budget 2026–27 factsheet: Minimum tax on discretionary trusts

stats.value: The Treasurer has confirmed the Government is examining options for the treatment of capital gains of small and startup businesses where indexation applies to a low or zero cost base
stats.source: SmartCompany — Labor considers startup CGT changes after founder backlash
stats.notes: Options reportedly include letting qualifying startups keep the 50% discount or a concession close to current arrangements.
